_doc: Premium 'sets' (Round 14, 22 Nov 2026). The room behind the person is tinted (the person is the cut-out above it, so skin is untouched); one accent family per reel. premium.py rotates: never the same theme as the last two reels when another fits. word_style = default look of the word behind the head (numbers always use 'outline').
